target_estimands.interpretation: Compare workforce, compensation, value-added and capital changes across plants with rapid declines or rises in carbon intensity. Keep intermediate and verified zero-carbon endpoint cases visible. These are simultaneous observed associations, not effects of decarbonisation.
target_estimands.limits: Primary interval: 2017–2019. Registered alternatives: 2019–2022 and 2010–2022. Annualized log intensity change uses the actual elapsed calendar years. Verified zero-carbon endpoint cases remain in separate non-log diagnostics, as specified in D9_DEC04–06.
